references.text: The elders of Gilead offer Jephthah to become their leader, as confirmed here in verse 11
The Gileadites gathered at Mizpah, the same place where Jephthah later spoke his words before the Lord
Samuel gathered the people at Mizpah before the Lord, just as Jephthah spoke before the Lord at Mizpah
Mizpah as a gathering point for Israel where they sought the Lord
Mizpah as a gathering place for the tribes of Israel to make important decisions before the Lord
Vows and words spoken before the Lord are binding, just as Jephthah spoke all his words before the Lord
Making vows before the Lord obligates one to keep them
